anchors.paper_title: Concurrent category-selective neural activity across the ventral occipito-temporal cortex supports a non-hierarchical view of human visual recognition
anchors.reason: Same authors, N=140 SEEG participants, face FPVS across VOTC; the eLife study paper reports exactly this data (dataset described by it, released on OSF).

metadata.methods_description: Intracerebral recordings were acquired with Micromed systems at 256, 500 or 512 Hz during fast periodic visual stimulation (objects at 6 Hz, faces every 5th image). Recordings were imported in Letswave 5, segmented into stimulation sequences (2 s before onset to 2 s after the end) and merged per participant. Contact positions are given in Talairach space with anatomical labels.
